**Texere 0.4.14** · 12 November 2026

- **Focus mode: Cmd + Shift + D** (Ctrl + Shift + D on Windows) hides everything except the files you have open; the same shortcut brings everything back. In 0.4.13 it was Cmd + Option + F, which on Mac is Obsidian's own Find and replace and took over.

Also in this version (from 0.4.13, 0.4.12): focus mode; Reload after an update reloads all of Obsidian.

Update: the **Update** button on Texere's home page, or BRAT at startup.
